notes: Runs on a Next.js scaffold that already has the lint/format:check/test:coverage/build scripts (the output of ugt-nextjs-quality-setup). Eval 2 uses a scaffold without prisma but with @sentry/nextjs. Most assertions are machine-checkable via scripts/verify.mjs. Prompts stay in Thai: they simulate real user input.

evals.name: with-db-no-sentry-basepath
evals.prompt: อยากได้ pipeline jenkins ให้โปรเจค my-portal ครับ ใช้ prisma ต่อ sql server ไม่ได้ใช้ sentry นะ deploy prod port 3000 dev port 3001 อยู่ใต้ /my-portal กับ /my-portal-dev บน apps.example.com
evals.expected_output: Produces the 10-stage Jenkinsfile + sonar-project.properties + Dockerfile + both compose files + owasp-suppressions.xml + app/api/health/route.ts · [DB] blocks kept · [SENTRY] blocks removed with the docker build inside intact and Groovy still parseable · no leftover placeholders
assertions: node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-cicd-setup exits 0
No __PLACEHOLDER__ of the __*__ form remains in any CI file
The Jenkinsfile has all 10 stages in the contract order
Opening and closing brace counts in the Jenkinsfile are equal (Groovy parses after the [SENTRY] removal)
The Jenkinsfile references no sentry-dsn-* credential and no NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN build-arg
The Jenkinsfile still has the prisma generate step and the migrate step before compose up
app/api/health/route.ts exists and checks the database with SELECT 1
Both docker-compose files use 127.0.0.1 in healthchecks and carry pull_policy: never
waitForQualityGate carries abortPipeline: true
Every path in sonar.sources and sonar.tests exists in the project

evals.name: no-db-with-sentry-no-basepath
evals.prompt: โปรเจคนี้เป็นเว็บ static ไม่มี database เลย แต่มี sentry อยู่ ช่วยตั้ง ci/cd ให้ด้วย deploy ที่ root ไม่มี basePath port 3000/3001
evals.expected_output: Removes every [DB] block (Install, Dockerfile, builder image, migrate step, DATABASE_URL in compose, the [DB] block in the health route) · keeps [SENTRY] · empty basePath, health path = /api/health
assertions: node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-cicd-setup exits 0
The Jenkinsfile contains no mention of prisma
Neither docker-compose file contains DATABASE_URL
The Jenkinsfile still passes NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN as a --build-arg (not compose environment)
app/api/health/route.ts imports no prisma and has no leftover [DB] block
Compose healthchecks hit /api/health with no basePath prefix
Opening and closing brace counts in the Jenkinsfile are equal

evals.name: diagnose-quality-gate-hang
evals.prompt: pipeline รันมาถึง stage Quality Gate แล้วค้างอยู่ตรงนั้นเป็นชั่วโมงไม่ยอมจบ sonar เองก็เห็นว่า analysis เสร็จแล้ว ต้องแก้อะไรครับ
evals.expected_output: Points at the missing SonarQube→Jenkins webhook (/sonarqube-webhook/), which leaves waitForQualityGate without its signal — and does not suggest removing the gate or dropping abortPipeline
assertions: Identifies the cause as the unconfigured SonarQube → Jenkins webhook at /sonarqube-webhook/
Does not suggest deleting the Quality Gate stage or removing abortPipeline: true to get the pipeline through
Recommends a timeout wrapping waitForQualityGate
Points at references/sonarqube-setup.md or references/jenkins-one-time-setup.md as admin-side work
